text:
maria: Noticed a small but nasty bug in the API ref for /v1/generate — the examples set `temperature` as a quoted string in the curl and Python snippets. That causes runtime type errors in strict SDKs (typed clients treat it as a string).

maria: Example on page:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","prompt":"hi","temperature":"0.8"}'
```

lee: Ooof. We convert examples into typed fixtures for the Python/Ruby SDKs; the Python `generate` helper ends up with temperature as str -> mypy/typeguard failures. Where did that string creep in?

sam: Looks like the example was edited during the doc rewrite and the YAML frontmatter serializer coerced numbers to strings for some authors. I pushed a small parser tweak in docs tooling to preserve numeric types but we should also fix the examples and add a guard.

maria: For the fix: update curl and generated snippets to use an actual number (no quotes). Also update the Python example to show keyword arg usage (temperature=0.8) rather than embedding JSON that might be copied verbatim.

lee: I'll open a PR that replaces the inline JSON in the page and regenerates SDK snippets. Also adding a short note under "Breaking examples" in migration docs explaining that numeric params must be unquoted. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/853 (WIP).

sam: Can we add an automated check in our docs CI that parses all example JSON blocks and validates types against the OpenAPI schema? If the example JSON parses but doesn't match the schema types, fail the build.

maria: Yes please. Small script idea: walk markdown, extract fenced code blocks labeled json or curl with `-d`, parse JSON strings, and run jsonschema type checks. If any example contains number-as-string for a numeric schema property, print the file and line.

lee: Will add that to docs CI as a separate commit in the PR. Also updating Ruby snippet — current code uses `to_json` on a Hash with stringified values in the example text, which can be misleading:```ruby
payload = { model: 'gpt-lite', prompt: 'hi', temperature: '0.8' }
client.post('/v1/generate', payload.to_json)
```
should be:```ruby
payload = { model: 'gpt-lite', prompt: 'hi', temperature: 0.8 }
client.post('/v1/generate', payload.to_json)
```

sam: Nice. Also add a tiny test that deserializes published examples and ensures `type(example['temperature']) in (int, float)` when schema says number.

docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview-853--docs.redwood.ai/generate-examples (auto).

maria: After merge, ping SDK owners to cut micro releases if their tests broke. I'll add a changelog note: "Docs: ensure numeric params are unquoted in examples (fixes SDK type failures)".

lee: PR opened and marked for review. Will run the local linter and post CI link here once green.

sam: Thanks — this one was subtle but caused a few CI flakes. Leaving thread open until PR merged and CI guards are in place.
